cohort: The study included 221 very low birth weight infants (VLBWI) with hemodynamically significant patent ductus arteriosus (hsPDA) who underwent neurodevelopmental assessment at corrected 18-24 months of age.
finding: While PDA ligation was consistently associated with lower cognitive scores, severe intraventricular hemorrhage in very low birth weight infants emerged as a consistent risk factor for both PDA ligation and abnormal neurodevelopment at 18-24 months corrected age.
birth_weight: Very low birth weight infants (mean 907.31g in ligation group, 1006.07g in no-ligation group)
gest_age: Mean 27.02 weeks (ligation group) and 27.98 weeks (no-ligation group)
